answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 30062 Country: India Title: I need dua for 1. to do good study of software programming 2. to pass my job interview. Question: Assalamoalaikum mufti sahab I need dua for 1. to do good study of software programming 2. to pass my job interview. jazakAllah Answer ID: 30062 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 419/239/D=1432) The following is the most comprehensive dua in order to get success for a lawful and good purpose: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ Supplicate through this dua to get success in your aim. (2) Or recite the following dua and supplicate for your goal: يَا حيُّ يَا قَيُّوم بِرَحمَتِكَ اَسْتَغِيْثُ Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
